title: Physarum Stigmergy Simulation
description: Particles leave trails in a pixel grid and steer toward the highest concentration ahead of them as it diffuses and decays.

cogdoc.claim: Deposit into a diffusing, decaying shared medium is sufficient for global structure to emerge among agents that never communicate directly.

changes: head, after <title>: added an embedded <script type="application/cogdoc+yaml"> frontmatter block carrying the canonical cogdoc fields (id/type/title/sector/status/created/authors/tags) plus paper-specific claim, method[] (every slider declared with range, default, unit and meaning), observables, findings, limitations, and typed refs[]. Inert to the renderer (scripts of unknown type are not executed and do not display), so the file is simultaneously an indexable cogdoc of type `paper` and a running artifact — the .cog.html convention. Type `paper` is value 4 of the canonical 19-type enum in .cog/conf/spec/canonical-cogdoc-frontmatter-schema.cog.md and required `id` because it is a sequenced type.

reset()/imageData lifetime fix: the original called `const imageData = ctx.createImageData(width, height)` ONCE at top level immediately after the first reset(). Two failures followed. (1) A container reporting zero width at first layout made createImageData throw IndexSizeError, and because the throw was top-level the subsequent `animate()` call never ran — the simulation was permanently dead on that load, not merely unseeded; the resize listener then re-ran reset() successfully, so the canvas sized correctly and still nothing drew. (2) On any resize, reset() reallocated `grid`/`nextGrid` to the new dimensions while `imageData` retained the old ones, so the render loop wrote into a buffer of the wrong size. Fixed by declaring `let imageData` and reallocating it inside reset() alongside the grid, and by flooring both dimensions with Math.max(64, ...) so a zero-width parent cannot throw at all. This is the same repair welded_fields already carried at lines 249-265, whose comment 'reallocated with the grid, unlike the original' names this exact defect; the correction is now applied to the original rather than only annotated beside it. Verified in-browser after the fix: canvas 490x316, 25793 lit pixels, animation running, zero console errors.
version 1.0.0 -> 1.1.0: additive frontmatter plus a behavioral bug fix, no change to the model, its parameters, or its visual output.
